label: NIFC/WFIGS 2025 Historical Wildfire Perimeters
fixed_where_clause: attr_IncidentTypeCategory = 'WF' AND attr_FireDiscoveryDateTime >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND attr_FireDiscoveryDateTime < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'

display_geometry.purpose: cartographic display only; not for acreage or burn-severity analysis

chunking.feature_assignment: one chunk per fire using representative point
chunking.chunk_bbox: actual union bounds of all full display geometries in the chunk
chunking.future_loading: Dashboard loads only chunks whose bbox intersects the map viewport.

overview.purpose: Lightweight zoomed-out display only; full annual archive remains in viewport chunks.

science_note: WFIGS polygons represent mapped wildfire extent, not soil burn severity.
completeness_note: This rolling operational history intentionally uses modern WFIGS years only. NIFC documents full-history records before 2021 as incomplete.
